info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fraud Resolution Inquiry API
info.description: This API allows users to query and assess fraud resolution cases within the banking compliance framework. It facilitates the retrieval of detailed information regarding specific fraud incidents by leveraging unique identifiers. Typical consumers include compliance officers and fraud investigation teams who need access to historical data for analysis and decision-making. The endpoint supports enhancing operational efficiency by streamlining inquiries related to fraud resolutions.

get.description: Fetches the detailed information regarding the fraud resolution for the specified resource ID. This endpoint provides insights into the resolution process and findings related to the reported fraud case.
